sheet.description: Typed reception form headed 'Radiogramas captados por la Oficina Central de Enlace Radiotelegrafico'. It carries three transmissions, each with its own 'Recibido' line; this message is the first.

carries.text: Son catorce mil doscientas pesetas. Roca.
[...] limitada Carranza y Bernhardt promete concurso ola enumerado en 8 ola enumerado retaco de la misma.

receipt_stamps.body: Estado Mayor del Ministerio de la Guerra / SECCION DE INFORMACION / ENTRADA
Estado Mayor del Ministerio de la Guerra / SECCION DE INFORMACION / GABINETE DE CIFRA
receipt_stamps.note: the number and time boxes are blank

date_note: Dated three ways: the transmission line (day 11, 02.00), the 'Recibido' line (03.05, 11-12-936) and both stamps.
recipient: Comandante Militar de Baleares (Palma de Mallorca)
body: AGSZ FAEQ LHDF URWM PHEF FFNR <PLAIN: de que me da cuenta en sus telegramas es> AIAO SSCA OLZW HVMK GYKS ZHDL MCHI RCEQ SSUY JMXB OAUD UXFR USFT AIRA THLW RQKK TJOX GCCO PYCV ZZJW RXHF BVVP FAVA VBDD PVQH LFMJ UJRA TOMX
notes: After the sixth group the operator lapsed into clear; the passage is marked <PLAIN: ...> and is not ciphertext. The machine was paused, not reset, so the rotor state runs across it. Two two-group blocks stood twice in the transmission as taken down (FAEQ LHDF and OLZW HVMK); each is kept once here.

solution.reading: PONER QUE MOVIMIENTO BARCOS «de que me da cuenta en sus telegramas es» CONSECUENCIA NUESTRO CACAREADO DESEMBARCO TOME PRECAUCIONES POR SI ENEMIGO INTENTASE ALGUNA ACCION SOBRE MALLORCA O IBIZA [WW]
